$ uv run --group broker python scripts/measure_cache.py

24 callers, one key, expiring at the same moment:
  without single flight   24 of them recomputed it
  with single flight      1 of them recomputed it

And the eviction policy this server starts with: noeviction.
That is not a cache. When memory runs out it REFUSES writes rather than dropping
old keys, and the write fails with OutOfMemoryError. A last-value cache configured this
way stops accepting quotes at the moment there are more of them than usual, and
the error surfaces at the writer, so the first symptom is a producer failing for
a reason that has nothing to do with the producer.
